CocoSgt/dsh-attachments"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A third-party attachment plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): **bring any file into the conversation, "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"zero type rejection**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Every file — images included — goes through the stash pipeline**: the file is written to the ses"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"sion workspace at `<cwd>/.dsh/uploads/` and staged per session, and a card (icon tile + file name + "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"size + ✕) appears above the composer. Nothing uses the host's native draft-image pipeline (`createDr"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"aftImages`/`addImages` are not used); if the model needs to see an image, it reads it by path with t"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"he harness-native `read_image` tool, so non-vision models are never blocked by "this model doesn't s"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"upport images".
- **The draft stays completely clean** — no reference text is ever written into the "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"input box. When you send your next message, the host folds the attachment list into the model reques"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"t during the `agent/pre-step` wave as a message with `source: { kind: 'user' }` (inserted right befo"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"re your message, same injection pattern as the official dsh-agent-instructions), so it lands in the "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"logs and replays safely. After injection the cards disappear automatically.
- Whether — and how — to"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" handle a file is the model's business. The plugin does no type sniffing, so there is no "unsupporte"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"d format" rejection. The only hard limit is the 32 MB per-file RPC transfer cap (put larger files di"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"rectly into the project directory and reference the path in your message)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Entry points"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Paperclip button** (left end of the input toolbar): opens a file picker, multi-select, no `acce"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"pt` filter.
2. **Full-window drag & drop**: dragging files anywhere over the window shows an overlay"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" hint; drop to bring them in.
3. **Paste**: pasting files lands them through the same intake. Pastin"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"g text that contains attachment reference lines (`📎 … → .dsh/uploads/…`, e.g. copied from a previous"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" message) re-materializes them as cards."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Attachment cards"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Stashed files render as cards above the composer (`conversation.input.dock`): extension icon tile + "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"file name + size + ✕. The ✕ removes the file from the session stash and deletes it from disk. Image "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"cards carry a local thumbnail preview. Cards are backed by the host-side pending list as the source "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"of truth (`listStash`) and refresh via 2-second polling (they vanish once the stash is consumed by a"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" send). Clicking a card opens a preview overlay: images render directly, text/code render as plain t"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ext, everything else offers "open with system app", and the header carries a "copy reference" action"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" whose text is the attachment's wire format — paste it back into the composer to re-attach."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): `AttachmentsGateway` extends `TypertRemoteService` and serves the "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"`fileStash` namespace with **six RPCs**: `stashFile`, `removeStash`, `restageFile`, `clearStash`, `r"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"eadStash`, `listStash`. Path safety: writes only under `<cwd>/.dsh/uploads/`, file names are sanitiz"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ed and prefixed with a timestamp, and removal/preview paths are resolved and prefix-checked. Because"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" third-party dual-copy setups are blind to SRC discovery, the plugin also registers a weak (src-json"},{"id":"p12s6","text":") manifest into the host typert registry.
- **Browser half** (`lib/client.js`): hand-written strict "},{"id":"p12s7","text":"zod descriptors mounted via `$mount`, exposing `ctx.remote.fileStash`; the button registers `convers"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ation.input.left`, the card bar registers `conversation.input.dock`; full-window drag/paste routes t"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"hrough the "current composer" context captured by the store. The host folds pending attachments into"},{"id":"p12s10","text":" the next `agent/pre-step` decision.
- **Localization**: full zh/en dictionaries registered through "},{"id":"p12s11","text":"the harness locale service (namespace `dsh-attachments`). Slot components receive the standard react"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"ive `t` seat; window-level modules (dropzone overlay, preview, history cards, intake toasts) transla"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"te at call time via a namespace-bound `t`. Host-side RPC failures carry a stable dot-code plus `{nam"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"e}` params (e.g. `stash.err.tooLarge` with `{max}`) alongside a Chinese fallback message — the clien"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"t renders the localized text when its dictionary has the code, otherwise the fallback. The `📎 … → pa"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"th` reference-line format injected into the model's history is protocol text and is never localized."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Install from npm:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"All three dsh plugins can be added in one command:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"GitHub fallback:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"> Note: a self-built profile's `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json` must list
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-b"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ase` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` in
> `dsh.profile.bundles`, otherwise startup hangs silently."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` afterwards. Uninstall:
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-attachments`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Companion plugins"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The other two plugins from the same suite:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- dsh-skills
(npm) — a skill hub: aggregate
skills scattered across Claude Code directories, project"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s, and `.skill`
packages into one global library, invocable from the "/" menu.
- dsh-inspector
(npm)"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" — an "Instruction
Files" panel showing the exact AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instruction chain in
effect fo"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"r the session, in real load order, with in-place editing and
skill-root status."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Stashing requires the session to have a workspace directory (cwd). **Without a workspace, every fi"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"le type fails** — there is nowhere to put the file.
- 32 MB per-file transfer cap (a JSON-wire reali"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ty); oversized files fail loudly, never silently.
- The pending stash lives in host memory: after a "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"dsh restart, unsent cards are gone (the files remain in the uploads directory and can be dragged in "},{"id":"p26s5","text":"again). With the same session open in multiple clients, cards follow host state truthfully: opening "},{"id":"p26s6","text":"or refreshing a page never clears the stash (loading is read-only), a send from any client consumes "},{"id":"p26s7","text":"the pending entries everywhere (cards vanish via polling; the uploaded files stay on disk because th"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"e sent message references them), and only the ✕ buttons remove files.
- `.dsh/uploads/` is not garba"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ge-collected automatically; the card ✕ deletes the corresponding file, and files referenced by alrea"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"dy-sent messages should be kept (history still points at them)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Note: host method parameter names ARE the RPC wire field names (Gateway SRC mode) — the build must n"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ever mangle parameter names."}],"truncated":true}
